label: Tautology strengthens K validity
meaning: A NECESSARY_16 tautology holds at every world of every frame under every valuation: by induction on the box-free formula, Kripke truth at a world is truth-functional truth under that world's atomic profile, which is one of the assignments the tautology quantifies. Exact strong-only-premise strength result; strictness by the K axiom (controls). On the truth-functional fragment the converse holds (controls), so the two senses coincide there.
